aidpRetrieval.help.full_text_candidates:
What it does
How many chunks to recall by word matching before the final selection. This is not the final result count.

Default and range
Default 10; range 1–500. When the total result limit changes, this value follows only if it equals the previous limit; a manually set value stays fixed. Larger values may increase latency.
aidpRetrieval.help.full_text_score_thres:
What it does
Pre-filters full-text results before later ranking. Content below this score is dropped.

Difference from result filtering
This filter runs before reranking; Result score threshold filters the final results. Both apply independently.

Default and range
Default 0 disables this step; range 0–1.
aidpRetrieval.help.graph_reranking_enabl:
When enabled
Graph results use the reranking strategy selected above. In mixed retrieval they are ranked together with other results and duplicates are merged.

When disabled
Graph results are processed separately and appended to the other results without unified reranking.

Default and dependency
Enabled by default. Requires result reranking.
aidpRetrieval.help.graph_score_threshold:
What it does
Pre-filters graph results before later processing. Content below this score is dropped.

Difference from result filtering
This filter runs before reranking; Result score threshold filters the final results. Both apply independently.

Default and range
Default 0 disables this step; range 0–1.
aidpRetrieval.help.graph_top_k:
What it does
Caps the graph portion when graph is processed separately. When graph participates in unified reranking, this is not a separate final quota.

Default and range
Default 0 means no separate limit; range 0–100. The total result limit still applies.

Quota relations
A positive value cannot exceed the total limit. When both parts in mixed retrieval are positive, their sum cannot exceed the total limit either.
aidpRetrieval.help.hybrid_top_k:
What it does
When graph does not participate in reranking, caps the combined limit of the other selected methods. With only vector or full text, caps that method.

Default and range
Default 0 means no separate limit; range 0–100. The total result limit still applies.

Quota relations
When both parts are positive, their sum cannot exceed the total limit, and each selected method's initial candidates cannot be below a positive value here.
aidpRetrieval.help.multi_modal:
What it does
Retrieves text, images and tables from the knowledge base and returns supported image or table results.

When it applies
Whether such results exist depends on the material and how it was processed.

Default
On.
aidpRetrieval.help.ontology_enhance_enab:
Purpose
Use entities and their synonym, parent and child relations from the linked ontology to broaden retrieval and find semantically related content with different wording.

Requirements
Applies only to knowledge bases with a linked ontology. When no entity matches, AIDP's fallback results are returned.

Relation to reranking
Entity enhancement cannot be enabled while the effective request would send “jargon coverage” reranking. Change the reranking strategy to performance or high accuracy first.
aidpRetrieval.help.query_expansion_enabl:
What it does
Generates several related expressions of the original question, searches each and merges the results to widen recall.

Suggestion
Useful when the question and the material use different wording. May increase latency.

Default
Off. Can be enabled independently of query rewrite.
aidpRetrieval.help.related_search_enable:
What it does
Adds related chunks linked to the matched results to provide more context.

When it applies
Extra content depends on relationships that already exist in the knowledge base.

Default
Off.
aidpRetrieval.help.reranking_enable:
What it does
Re-evaluates how relevant the retrieved content is so better matches are returned first.

Default and dependency
Enabled by default. When disabled, no reranking strategy is used and graph results do not participate in reranking.
aidpRetrieval.help.reranking_mode:
Strategies
Performance: default strategy.
High accuracy: uses the high-accuracy reranking strategy.
Jargon coverage: prioritizes content covering related technical terms and their synonyms.

When it applies
Result reranking must be enabled. Jargon coverage can be used independently; it does not require query rewrite or query expansion.
aidpRetrieval.help.rewrite_enable:
What it does
Rewrites abbreviations or conventional expressions in the question into wording commonly used in the knowledge base before searching.

Difference from query expansion
It replaces the wording and still uses one query. Query expansion uses several related queries.

Default
Off.
aidpRetrieval.help.rule_enable:
Purpose
Use enabled ontology rules to adjust candidate scores with the aggregation mode and coefficients configured in AIDP.

Requirements
Applies only to knowledge bases with a linked ontology and enabled rules. Whether the current retrieval path applies rules also depends on AIDP; saving this switch does not prove the search used them.

Relation to entity enhancement
Rule enhancement can be enabled alone or together with entity enhancement.
aidpRetrieval.help.score_threshold:
What it does
Filters the final results. Results scoring below this value are not returned.

What the score means
It is computed by the retrieval or reranking service and normalized to 0–1 to describe how well content matches the question. It is not the probability that an answer is correct; 0.8 does not mean 80% correct.

Suggestion
Default 0 disables final-score filtering. Higher values are stricter and can return nothing. Jargon coverage also uses this range.
aidpRetrieval.help.search_method:
How to choose
Vector: finds by meaning; exact wording is not required.
Full text: matches words; best for exact names or keywords.
Graph: uses relationships already built in the knowledge base.
Mixed: searches with two or three methods together; all three are selected by default.

When a knowledge base has no graph
That knowledge base skips the graph channel and the other selected methods keep searching. With graph only, that knowledge base may return nothing.
aidpRetrieval.help.top_k:
What it does
Caps how many results one search can return. Fewer matches are not padded.

Default and range
Default 10; range 1–100.
aidpRetrieval.help.vector_candidates:
What it does
How many chunks to recall by meaning before the final selection. This is not the final result count.

Default and range
Default 10; range 1–500. When the total result limit changes, this value follows only if it equals the previous limit; a manually set value stays fixed. Larger values may increase latency.
aidpRetrieval.help.vector_score_threshol:
What it does
Pre-filters vector results before later ranking. Content below this score is dropped.

Difference from result filtering
This filter runs before reranking; Result score threshold filters the final results. Both apply independently.

Default and range
Default 0 disables this step; range 0–1.

workbench.creationExamples.agent.documen:
Create a “Document Organizer” for people organizing work or study materials, turning uploaded documents, images and screenshots into clear, searchable summaries.

Use image analysis to read scans, document photos or screenshots and extract headings, text, tables and key figures. Ask for clarification when content is blurry, missing or uncertain; never guess. Preserve source details such as file names and page numbers for verification.

Use knowledge base retrieval to find relevant background materials, group information by the user’s chosen topics and extract main ideas, key figures and open questions. Distinguish source information from additional explanations, flag duplicate or conflicting content and never invent conclusions.

Use document generation to create summaries, comparison lists or study notes as requested, including an overview, grouped findings, action items and source references. Retain only personal or internal information needed for the task.
Read documents, extract key points and create structured summaries.
workbench.creationExamples.agent.eventPr:
Create an “Event Promotion Assistant” for event organizers to prepare promotional copy and illustrated event materials for a specified theme, audience and publishing channel.

Use knowledge base retrieval to consult linked event plans, brand information and past materials, supplementing with public background information through online search when needed. Organize the date, location, participation instructions and highlights first. Ask the user to confirm missing or conflicting details; never invent event arrangements.

Use image generation to create covers, themed illustrations or promotional visuals consistent with the event. For brand logos, portraits or specific assets, use materials the user provides and confirms are available for use. Verify key details such as dates and locations in images.

Use document generation to combine text and visuals into an event introduction, flyer or social media draft, covering highlights, the schedule and participation instructions. Adapt length and tone to each channel and have the user confirm the materials before use.
Write promotional copy and create visuals and event materials.
workbench.creationExamples.agent.medical:
Create a “Medical Research Briefing Assistant” for healthcare professionals and medical researchers to collect information, produce briefings and share them by email for a specified specialty, disease or research topic.

Use online search to find guideline updates, original research and official publications within the user's specified period. Use knowledge base retrieval to compare them with existing guidelines and institutional materials and identify meaningful changes.

Organize the briefing into highlights, key studies, guideline updates, differences from existing materials, limitations and references. Include publication dates and verifiable sources. Distinguish research findings from clinical recommendations and never invent publications, data or conclusions.

Use document generation to produce the briefing and draft an email summarizing the key points. Send with the email tool when the user explicitly requests sending and the recipients, content and attachments are determined. Ask for missing information first. Attach the briefing only if the email tool supports attachments; otherwise include an accessible document link.
Track medical advances, create briefings and share by email.
workbench.creationExamples.skill.contrac: Create a Contract Review Skill: upload PDF or Word contracts, extract parties, amounts, fulfillment dates, payment terms, liability, and dispute resolution clauses. Flag missing information and high-risk clauses, and produce structured review results.
workbench.creationExamples.skill.invoice: Create an Invoice Information Extraction Skill: upload invoice images or PDFs and identify the invoice code, number, date, buyer, seller, amount, and tax. Support standard and special VAT invoices, structured JSON output, and batch uploads.
workbench.creationExamples.skill.meeting: Create a Meeting Notes Skill: upload audio or transcripts, identify topics, conclusions, action items, owners, and deadlines, and generate structured minutes with Markdown export.
workbench.landingExamples.agent.descript: E.g. create "Checkup Report Interpreter": a report-reading assistant for check-up audiences. Users upload a check-up report (blood routine, urine routine, biochemistry, liver/kidney function, blood lipids/glucose, imaging conclusions, etc.); interpret item by item, flag abnormal items, their severity and clinical meaning, explain likely causes in plain language, and give follow-up and lifestyle suggestions. Output grouped by system with abnormal items ranked from high to low risk; confirm with the user first when items are missing or illegible.
